title: MapManager
description: Mass selection, quick removal, custom icons, pinning and sorting.
body:
**Map Management Tool:**
Selection: Hold Left Shift and left-click to select items.

Deletion: Press Delete on your keyboard or click Del in the top right corner to remove selected maps.

Change Icon: Select an item and click Icon to change its image. Note: Use perfectly square images (e.g., 128x128 px).

Pinning: Click the ★ icon next to a map to pin it to the top.

Sorting: Use the Newest or Oldest buttons to organize the list.

Size: The file size in megabytes (MB) is displayed next to each map.
